newsitem.title: USA: Teva extends CEO's term, grants options.
newsitem.headline: Teva extends CEO's term, grants options.

text.p: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd said on Tuesday it extended the term of its president and chief executive officer, Eli Hurvitz, for a further five-year term and it granted him stock options.
Hurvitz's term had been scheduled to expire in April.

The company said, subsequent to the approval of the audit committee, the board decided to grant Hurvitz stock options covering 250,000 American Depository Receipts (ADRs) at an option price of $39.50 per ADR.

The action was taken in light of Hurvitz's "unique and exceptional" contribution to the development of the company, Teva said. The allotment of options was subject to Hurvitz's consent to extend his term of office for a further five-year term, it said.
The allotment must be approved by shareholders, it said.
